scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('app/build.gradle.kts')||!fs.existsSync('settings.gradle.kts')){process.exit(1);}console.log('TG7 Editor Native Android workspace verified.');"
scripts.lint: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const req=['.github/workflows/build.yml','settings.gradle.kts','build.gradle.kts','app/build.gradle.kts','app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml','app/src/main/java/com/tg7/editor/MainActivity.kt'];for(const f of req){if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error('Missing:',f);process.exit(1);}}console.log('Native Android structure OK.');"
scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http');http.createServer((_,res)=>{res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':'text/plain; charset=utf-8'});res.end('TG7 Editor Native Android (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + Media3) — Push to GitHub main to build TG7-Editor-Debug.apk via Actions.');}).listen(3000,'0.0.0.0',()=>console.log('Listening on 3000'));"
